---
name: Something in a model looks wrong
about: An assumption, a method, or a number that does not hold up
labels: model
---

Thank you - this is exactly the kind of thing we want to hear.

**What are you looking at?**
A simulation ID, a rule file, or a published figure.

**What looks wrong?**
The assumption, the method, the input data, or the result.

**How do you know?**
A source, your own analysis, or professional experience. All three are useful, and experience
is real evidence - just tell us that is what it is.

**Would it change the conclusion?**
Only if you can tell. No need to work it out for us.
